# klygo

> Python utilities for archive handling, filesystem operations, configuration, dataset management, and object detection.

Klygo offers modular functional APIs and selected stateful interfaces.

## Documentation

- [Archive operations](docs/archive/README.md)
- [Archive backend interfaces](docs/archive/backend/README.md)
- [Filesystem and path operations](docs/files/README.md)
- [Configuration](docs/config/README.md)
- [Dataset operations](docs/datasets/README.md)
- [Utilities](docs/utils/human_size.md)

## Guidance for coding assistants

1. Import public APIs from package facades, such as `from klygo import files, archive, config`.
2. Functional APIs return independent values unless mutation is explicitly documented.
3. File and archive operations accept `str` and text-returning `os.PathLike[str]` inputs.
4. Set `overwrite=True` when replacing existing outputs where supported.
5. Archive extraction protects against path traversal.
